result.summary: The page layout is mostly consistent, but there is a minor visual issue with the promotional badge overlapping the pizza image inconsistently compared to other cards.

issues.description: The '-100%' badge on the pizza promotion card uses a different color/style (white text on dark background) compared to the '€0 delivery' badge style used elsewhere, creating slight visual inconsistency in badge design.
